name: @pcc/adapter-galaxy-synbiocad
description: Galaxy-SynBioCAD adapter for PCC — exposes the brsynth synthetic-biology / metabolic-engineering tool suite (RetroPath2.0, rpTools, Selenzyme, PartsGenie, DNA-Bot, DNA Weaver, StrainDesign, OptDOE, iCFree, AMN/DAMN, ...) as a digital kernel. One catalog-driven executor runs any tool over the Galaxy REST API; ships a JSON-Schema capability catalog agents pick from.
